captionLines: The People of the State of New York, Respondent,
dateLines: Appeal, by permission of an Associate Judge of the Court of Appeals, from an order of the Appellate Division of the Supreme Court in the Second Judicial Department, entered June 28, 2023. The Appellate Division affirmed a judgment of the Supreme Court, Kings County (Dena E. Douglas, J.), which had convicted defendant, upon a jury verdict, of robbery in the first degree, criminal mischief in the fourth degree, and criminal possession of a weapon in the fourth degree.
